$Comment: A day errand on Old Jack's errands board (Hallows_Eve_Errands), half of his board's Lantern Barrage: half the throws, and half its flat pay, with the board's own pay table on top. Its Boards entry names the errands board and its day band, which replaces the base's whole list. USE_ITEM with the Qualifier Throw counts a thrown Lantern Bomb of any tier: the PREFIX match takes every id starting Hallows_Eve_Lantern_Bomb_. It writes its own Rewards.Claim because a child's list replaces the base's whole: the pay waits at the errands board until the player collects it. MMO Skill Tree's Mmo_Xp row (Artillery XP for the throws) carries its own Requires, the hytale:mod_installed gate, which leaves the row out on a server without that mod while the rest of the errand pays.
